blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Warehousing & Fulfillment — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the warehousing & fulfillment operating unit of Logistics & Supply Chain.

Fulfillment is throughput economics: pick rates, dock scheduling, labor allocation and inventory truth. Orchestrated robots, vision-verified quality and agentic labor planning compound into cost-per-order leadership.

items: Shift planning vs. volume waves manual; overtime and missed SLAs.
Cycle-count programs lag; phantom stock breaks promises.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Hyperautomation & Systems Integration, Agentic Process Automation from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Slotting and pick-path, Wave/order batching, Labor planning) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Worker-safety rules among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end — extraction, validation and downstream action.
See the work as it actually runs — event-log truth before you automate anything.
